visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair appears in a selfie-view shot, wearing a white fluffy scarf. A digital filter is applied to her face, adding sparkles and skin-smoothing effects. The lighting is bright and warm, and a retro camera frame overlay is visible. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of the woman indoors, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt. She speaks directly to the camera while gesturing with her hands and pointing her index finger upwards. The background consists of soft beige curtains and a neutral-toned headboard. (3) The woman covers her eye with her hand and then removes it to demonstrate that the digital eye makeup from the filter stays perfectly in place. Her facial expressions are lively, with wide eyes and a slight smile. (4) She holds a white water bottle with a pink sticker and takes a sip. She then points to the rim of the bottle to show that no lipstick marks were left, highlighting the filter's lip-tint effect. (5) She puts on a pair of metallic-framed glasses, followed by white-framed sunglasses. The camera is steady as she demonstrates how the facial filter adjusts and remains stable even when wearing accessories. (6) A transition occurs to a screen recording of a mobile interface. It shows the App Store for TikTok, followed by the TikTok app interface where she searches for a specific account and saves a particular filter effect. (7) Returning to the camera, the woman is seen wearing large white fluffy earmuffs over her ears. She claps her hands together and smiles at the camera, with the sparkly filter still active over her face. (8) The video concludes with a static graphic screen featuring a light pink background, a cartoon illustration of a girl with glasses, and text overlays for social media handles and call-to-action messages.
